import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    n = data[0]
    total = 0
    if n > 0:
        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            total += data[i]
    print(total // n)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
